lines.en: This issue's special: holding hands.
(gulp) …Hold her hand.

lines.text: 형… 지금 자기 손 잡고 있어?
lines.en: Bro… are you holding your own hand?

lines.text: 실험 중이다. 결과, 아무 느낌 없음.
lines.en: It's an experiment. Result: nothing.
My hand is the same skin,

lines.text: 왜 남의 손만 설렐까? 지금부터 진지하다.
lines.en: so why does only someone else's hand feel special? Serious mode on.

lines.text: 첫째. 혼자 간지럼 태우면 안 간지럽지?
lines.en: One. You can't tickle yourself, right?

lines.text: 뇌가 내 손이 어디 닿을지 미리 알고, 느낌을 깎아버려.
lines.en: Your brain predicts where your hand will land and turns the feeling down.
Ah… so it's been spoiled.

lines.text: 그래. 결말 아는 애니는 안 설렌다.
lines.en: Exactly. An anime you know the ending of never thrills.

lines.text: 둘째. 남이 만지면 뇌의 감정 쪽까지 켜지는데,
lines.en: Two. Someone else's touch lights up the brain's emotional areas,

lines.text: 내가 만지면 오히려 조용해져. 그 차이가 척수에서부터 보인대.
lines.en: but your own touch quiets them. The difference shows up as early as the spinal cord.
Your spine's quicker on the uptake than you.

lines.text: 셋째. 피부엔 천천히 쓰다듬을 때 제일 신나는 느린 신경이 있어.
lines.en: Three. Your skin has slow nerves that love being stroked gently.
Scientists think they're built to recognize a caring touch.
And where do you use that?
…On a cat. It ran away.
Four. Wives waiting for an electric shock

lines.text: 남편 손을 잡게 했더니, 뇌가 덜 무서워했대.
lines.en: held their husband's hand, and their brains were less afraid.

lines.text: 모르는 사람 손은 효과가 작았고, 사이가 좋을수록 더 컸어.
lines.en: A stranger's hand helped less, and happier couples got more.
See? It's gotta be my hand.

lines.text: 다섯째. 아플 때 연인 손을 잡으면 두 사람 뇌파가 맞춰지고,
lines.en: Five. When partners hold hands through pain, their brainwaves sync,
and the better they synced, the less it hurt.
And who have you synced with?
…My Wi-Fi.

lines.text: 결론. 남의 손은, 내 뇌가 예측 못 하는 손이다.
lines.en: Conclusion: another person's hand is the one hand your brain can't predict.

lines.text: 그러니 연구를 위해, 동생 손을 잠깐…
lines.en: So, for science, may I borrow your hand for a sec…
No.
Sample collection: failed.
Honey, let's go for a walk.
(taking her hand) Sure.
(gulp) …Insufficient control group.
